DUMBDROP_PIN.description: Generated ten-digit native PIN. The separate owner gateway must also remain enabled.

MAX_FILE_SIZE.description: Max file size for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AUTO_UPLOAD.description: Auto upload for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for dumbdrop. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for dumbdrop. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for dumbdrop. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.
